documents.title: Hyperagents
documents.abstract: Hyperagents defines self-referential and self-improving programs. The framework emphasizes recursive metacognitive self-modification and adaptation over time.

documents.title: Group-Evolving Agents: Open-Ended Self-Improvement via Experience Sharing
documents.abstract: A multi-agent system where agents improve by sharing experiences and reusable skills. Targets open-ended self-improvement in collaborative settings.

documents.title: AgentFactory: A Self-Evolving Framework Through Executable Subagent Accumulation and Reuse
documents.abstract: AgentFactory accumulates and reuses executable subagents to continuously expand capabilities. Focuses on growth by composition and retention of effective agent behaviors.

documents.title: SAGE: Multi-Agent Self-Evolution for LLM Reasoning
documents.abstract: SAGE applies self-evolution to improve large language model reasoning through multi-agent refinement loops.

documents.title: EvoSkill: Automated Skill Discovery for Multi-Agent Systems
documents.abstract: EvoSkill studies automated skill discovery and selection in multi-agent workflows.

documents.title: SEMAG: Self-Evolutionary Multi-Agent Code Generation
documents.abstract: SEMAG applies self-evolutionary multi-agent methods to code generation and iterative repair.

documents.title: HyperAgent: Generalist Software Engineering Agents to Solve Coding Tasks at Scale
documents.abstract: HyperAgent is a software-engineering automation framework for coding tasks at scale. It is distinct from Hyperagents (2026) and does not define recursive metacognitive self-modification.
